newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Olympic Group raising capital to $81 mln.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Olympic Group raising capital to $81 mln.

text.p: Private Egyptian firm Olympic Group Financial Investment Company (OGFI) has said it was raising its paid-up capital to 275 million pounds ($81 million) from 200 million through a private stock placement.
The firm said in a statement obtained by Reuters on Monday it was offering 7.5 million shares with a par value of 10 pounds each to a select group of institutions. The offer runs until August 7.
The offer price is 12.10 pounds and market analysts said the firm would distribute the 2.1 pound premium on its existing shareholders.

OGFI is the parent company of Cairo Precision Industries , Cairo Light Industries, Cairo Advanced Industries and several retail trading companies. Its subsidiaries manufacture heaters, water boilers, air conditioners, fans, vacuum cleaners and washing machines.
The firm raised net after tax profits in the first six months of 1997 to 19.80 million pounds from 2.015 million in the same period of the previous year. Its financial year is the calendar year.
It forecast net after tax profits in the first half of 1998 to rise to 28.20 million.
